Copper Arcade trades approach distance for an independent east entry to Sun Court.

The source names a separate small ramp area. In Sun Court approach slopes have explicit endpoints.
The Sun Court edge and Seal Gallery distribute the entry past paired obstructions into the court.
The Sun Court kindle disk is a new grounded objective, distinct from its architecture and decorative ring.

The gate gives an east or west decision and access to Rain Lane.
Two loom solids control the cross-view. The route remains persistent through a round.

Use the surveyed ramp and a landing readable from either direction.

Sailcloth Yard gathers the western routes before the descent.

Dyers’ Descent handles the grade transition as a 5 m ramp.
Loom Door branches to Sluice Walk. Source upper/lower stacking informs support checks.
Dye Gate is a persistent mouth with a separate lateral cover pair.
The higher source opening illustrates alternate exposure. No window-jump or required flight is part of the current B survey.
Indigo Cistern places the second ritual disk on dry stone below the central gate.
Retain the 74 unnamed records when reconciling coverage. A missing author label does not remove walkability.
